reviewer_statement: Developer-side frozen Python 1.2 scientific recovery frame semantic review of functional_recovery_frame, based on original simulate.py and typed FunctionalRecoveryResult records. Proposed twelve complete source data-frame differential cases across three linked functions and four source-science inputs, including failed replicates, flat and structured metrics, scenario sorting, error domains and NumPy quantile/SD arithmetic. Exact-head CI and independent certification remain pending; Python runtime class identity is not asserted for R.
native_language_semantic_policy: Python frozen recovery metric/record/result dataclasses map to validated native scientific R lists, pandas DataFrame to native source-ordered R data.frame with exact scientific numerical values and metadata. Default mean, SD and quantiles use NumPy-equivalent source behavior; legacy R arithmetic is a named explicit opt-out. Native implementations invoke no Python.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 simulate.py signature for typed FunctionalRecoveryResult, FunctionalRecoveryRecord, and FunctionalRecoveryValue dataclasses, native R scientific record mapping

Four distinct source-record configurations: structured source metrics, unstructured fallback metrics with missing metadata, every replicate failed, and nine successful observations with one failed replicate

Twelve complete typed Python 1.2 vs native R data.frame comparisons (four configurations by three exports) including every source column and numeric/nullable value, NumPy-source reduction and 5th/25th/50th/75th/95th quantiles, failure counts/MCSE

Native R constructor rejects unknown source statuses, nonfinite metrics, metrics on failed replicates, structured/flat source disagreements and malformed summary arithmetic choices; Python runtime exception types remain language-specific
Python pandas DataFrame values and source column order mapped to R data.frame, including zero-column empty metric observations and 19-column empty summary for all-failed source records
Per-simulation-replicate structured or flat metric evidence, zero-based to one-based component labels, exact metadata origin and missing fields with source-ordered long form

independent_review_status: Author full-source reviewed, exact-head Linux/Windows/macOS and pinned Python 1.2 differential CI pending; independent certification not granted.
language_specific_limits: Python pandas/index and frozen dataclass identities are semantic rather than identical R runtime classes
Python TypeError/ValueError exception classes cannot be identical to R native condition classes
Records containing non-representable >2^53-1 integer IDs are outside finite double-exact native R domain
These source-frame reviews do not certify underlying estimator or simulation RNG procedures
